lines.en: Would you like to respond?
lines.zh: 要回复吗？

lines.en: What would you like to say?
lines.zh: 你想说点什么？

lines.en: : {i}When did you take this?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你什么时候拍的这张？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}When Maya and I were waiting for you on the roof.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}就是我和 Maya 在屋顶上等你的时候。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}We weren't really sure how to pass the time, so I decided to take some pictures while Maya was all like grrrr I'm Maya.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我们不太确定怎么打发时间，所以我就趁 Maya 在那儿「我是 Maya 我超凶」的时候拍了几张。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}It's really weird, though! They seemed normal when I looked at them on the roof. But after we reset, the sky was gone in all of them.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不过真的很怪！在屋顶上看的时候它们还挺正常的。可我们重置之后，所有照片里的天空都不见了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Do you think it means anything?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你觉得这有什么含义吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I have no idea. Have you shown it to Maya?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我不知道。你给 Maya 看过了吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Yeah, but she doesn't have any idea either.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}看了，她也没头绪。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}It's the big black thing that weirds me out the most. Not a sex joke.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}最让我发毛的是那个巨大的黑色东西。不是性笑话。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}It's pretty much in the same exact spot where the moon was, but...idk. Looking at it makes me feel weird.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}它基本就在月亮原来那个位置，不过……我不知道。看着它让我觉得怪怪的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Kinda like it's watching us or something.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}有点像它在看着我们什么的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}It certainly does have a...threatening aura to it?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}它确实有种……威胁性的气场？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Right???{/i}
: {i}The slumber party thing didn't really work, but maybe we can try taking more pictures next time we're up there?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}睡衣派对那招没奏效，不过也许下次我们上去时可以多拍点照片？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Oooh, video too. We should try all sorts of stuff since doing the same thing over and over obviously hasn't worked for you guys.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哦哦，视频也拍。我们应该什么都试试——毕竟你们一遍遍做同样的事显然没用。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Well, I'm glad that you seem to be enjoying this.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗯，我很高兴你似乎挺享受这个的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I'm making the most of it. You should too.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我在充分利用它。你也该这样。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}It's scary, yeah. But we have each other. And we should do everything we can to keep each other comfortable while we're up there.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是挺可怕的，没错。可我们有彼此。我们在上面的时候，应该尽一切所能让彼此舒服些。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Everything except having sex, that is. Since Maya doesn't want to watch us for some reason.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}除了做爱之外的一切——因为 Maya 不知为什么不想看我们做。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I'm sure you know what that reason is, Ayane.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我确信你知道那个原因是什么，Ayane。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Yeah, I'm sure Maya does as well. And yet...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是啊，我确信 Maya 也知道。可即便如此……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Okay...well, if we're not going to talk about the picture anymore, I should probably go.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}好吧……那，如果我们不再聊这张照片了，我大概该走了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Same. I'm actually in the bath with Sana right now.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我也是。我现在其实正跟 Sana 一起泡澡。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Why didn't you send me that instead?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那你为什么不发那张给我？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Because Sana's tiny boobies aren't going to save the world.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}因为 Sana 那对小胸部救不了世界。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You don't know that.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这你可说不准。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Good point. Let's try and get her up there for the next reset.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}有道理。下次重置我们想办法把她也弄上去吧。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I'll talk to you later, [ayanemaster]. I love you :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}回头聊，[ayanemaster]。我爱你 :){/i}

lines.en: : {i}I love you too.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我也爱你。{/i}
